findings.contract: Stable owned input-admission errors and canonical lower source identities.
findings.evidence: All existing guard classifications remain anonymous anyhow bail/ensure; PBR migrated final finite guard to SurfaceMaterial but not its typed failure ownership.
findings.repair: One ExportAdmissionError + descriptive ExportAdmissionResult; typed body/shell subject and relevant payloads; canonical CharacterLodError at lod; no duplicate validator.

findings.contract: Native frame padding, complete additions and all u32 headers checked on actual payload lengths before any GLB path operations.
findings.evidence: next_multiple_of(4), usize total sum, as-u32 JSON/BIN/total and infallible Vec::with_capacity remain unchanged from old discovery.
findings.repair: Private checked layout and one prepared packet; actual TryFromIntError and TryReserveError retained; GlbError separates serde/layout/allocation/directory/write causes.

findings.contract: Actual exported body position/normal native words must be finite.
findings.evidence: Public body arrays only population checked, unlike shell arrays; NaN/Inf reaches BIN and bounds JSON.
findings.repair: Add finite positions/normals admission at same source boundary before compaction/native buffer construction; no norm-length/range or topology policy.

findings.contract: Retained raw joint states are actual finite source input to native transforms.
findings.evidence: Public globals table checked only for length; shell-only finite geometry plus NaN joint translation passes and reaches null node JSON/nonfinite inverse bind bytes.
findings.repair: Separate typed nonfinite source-state guard with actual ordinal before native construction. Negative/zero/denormal scale policy is not invented by this check.

findings.contract: Optional native hinge metadata components must be finite.
findings.evidence: Public optional hinge origin/axis bypass current geometry/PBR finite guard and serialize directly; nonfinite source becomes null JSON metadata.
findings.repair: Typed finite-only optional hinge admission; no normalization, length threshold, sign or physical solve policy.

findings.contract: Finite source alone does not certify representable finite native node/matrix output.
findings.evidence: Transform inverse divides by scale and compose/narrowing can overflow; zero or sufficiently tiny finite scale may produce nonfinite inverse-bind words, even after source finite guard.
findings.repair: Guard actual derived inverse-bind matrix and node to_skel_state f32 components at receiving projection; typed native projection error distinct from malformed source; retain exact math and all finite outputs. No positive-scale/clamp policy.

findings.contract: No production unwrap; typed native assembly is distinct from authored input.
findings.evidence: Known producer uses JSON primitives arrays but both private native transformations call unwrap.
findings.repair: Prefer direct actual Vec ownership if chosen before repair; otherwise fallible shape extraction with one focused ExportAssemblyError and descriptive alias. Propagate through existing top anyhow, no compatibility path.

findings.contract: No production expect; LOD accepted range stays at canonical owner.
findings.evidence: Formatter unconditionally expects TryFrom despite actual fallible API and explicit no-expect rule.
findings.repair: Handle formatting failure at actual UI boundary while retaining same valid display and no clamp; main load_body_model propagates canonical source via ?.

findings.contract: No production expect; optional profiling must not alter operation return/cause.
findings.evidence: GLB profiling wrappers invoke record, which expects serde encoding of Timing.
findings.repair: Handle diagnostic serialization result explicitly; keep generic measure<T> operation result intact and profiling optional. No new export error for telemetry or swallowed operation failure.

findings.contract: Public before private free functions; named semantic records and existing owner reuse; no-growth responsibilities.
findings.evidence: morphs private channels precedes public validate/write; channels carries semantic target/population tuple. Native parts use name/hinge/shell triple; native skeleton tuple and shell/skin view tuples encode semantic roles. These are source-backed rule debt, not demonstrated runtime failures.
findings.repair: Before editing each responsibility, choose named MorphChannel, native Parts/Nodes/SkinViews/ShellViews where touched; direct typed collection approach may close shape/tuple roles together. Move complete docs/attrs with items; keep existing production export oversized math outside expansion or extract only actual new responsibility.

final_api_recommendation.public_export: Keep export_rigged_glb(output,...,mesh,shells,sockets)->anyhow::Result<()>; existing callers and contexts naturally retain concrete typed roots through ?. Do not widen/duplicate a global export error merely to shorten this mixed operation.
final_api_recommendation.source_admission: New focused export/admission_error.rs: public ExportAdmissionError, ExportAdmissionResult<T>, ExportSubject::Body | Shell { index:usize, name:String }; closed column/morph/socket violation roles only where payload contract shares actual meaning. Error variants carry exact host counts and canonical RigJointOrdinal/RigJointCount where available. Own diagnostic strings only at error production; no string-driven branching.
final_api_recommendation.lod: lod.rs owns CharacterLodError with requested u8 and canonical MIN/MAX Display; TryFrom keeps Result<Self,Self::Error>, no alias-only trait signature. Do not copy range into export error or change stored u8 public input as incidental compatibility bridge. main loader ? retains source; formatter handles Err without expect.
final_api_recommendation.validation: validate/validate_shell/morphs::validate/validate_proportions use actual ExportAdmissionResult. Preserve original guard order where practical, signed/out-of-range UV acceptance, same skin tolerance and joint cap. If proportions move into initial admission to establish one phase, remove late duplicate and inventory changed error priority explicitly.
final_api_recommendation.native_assembly: One focused ExportAssemblyError/Result (or named equivalent) for current missing primitives/native object/children/root shape errors; canonical RigJointLookupError can remain a source variant. Either pass actual Vec<Value> rather than extracting array from Value, or use checked extraction. Do not return fabricated empty primitives; public top retains anyhow conversion. Typed native projection failures belong here or a focused sibling projection owner, not source admission.
final_api_recommendation.glb_error: glb/error.rs (or small glb.rs owner) exports GlbError and cohesive GlbResult<T>. Actual families Serialize(serde_json::Error), Layout(GlbLayoutError), Reserve(TryReserveError), CreateDirectory{path:PathBuf,source:io::Error}, Write{path:PathBuf,source:io::Error}. Derive Debug/Error with #[from]/#[source] as appropriate; no String cause or manual flattening. Publicly reexport errors needed for downcast/type classification; only genuinely public payload role types exposed.
final_api_recommendation.layout: Private glb/layout.rs GlbLayout constructor takes actual JSON Vec len and BIN Vec len; no Default/serde/public fields. Named ChunkLayout for json/bin and total32 certificate; store only private coherent derived fields needed by encode. GlbLengthRole::{Json,Bin,Container} names native field. Checked padding add and complete total add; Width{role,bytes,source:TryFromIntError} distinct from Overflow{role} which has no fabricated std cause.
final_api_recommendation.packet: Prepare from actual serde_json::to_vec(document)? and consumed BIN Vec; admit layout BEFORE any padding mutation/reserve/header/filesystem. Fallibly reserve exact final frame capacity once and write original payloads plus pad bytes into final Vec; avoid separate padded JSON/BIN reallocations. Prepared packet retains only complete bytes (layout can be consumed), so no competing mutable metadata. This is production format ownership, not a metadata-only testing adapter.
final_api_recommendation.writer: glb::write(path,document,bin)->GlbResult<()> constructs complete packet first, then existing mkdir and fs::write with exact paths/sources. Top uses glb::write(...)?;Ok(()) to convert into mixed anyhow. No GLB create/truncate/write on invalid layout or failed preparation; later IO may partially write, no transaction/rename framework.
final_api_recommendation.publication: TextureImages.finish still occurs first and may publish sibling PNGs / create parent directory. No all-output-atomicity claim. Keep hashes/cache/corrupt-shared-file rejection and surface alpha/sampler/image precedence exact.
final_api_recommendation.pbr: Retain validation of original SurfaceMaterial.is_finite. Writer applies SurfaceTextures::scalar_appearance then canonical LinearSurfaceMaterial::try_from; white selection precedes decode when base color map exists. Projection error remains SurfaceProjectionError source, not recoded as UV/missing-map/admission error. Finite out-of-unit source factors remain accepted where representable, no recipe bounds/clamp added.
final_api_recommendation.fixtures: No new tests/cases/helpers/assertions/doctests/probes. Existing whole fixture source read; only necessary API/import/? adaptations allowed. Preserve oracles skin weights sum, ordered morph rejection/matching/NaN,4..=6 u8 loop, GLB native parse/image/skin/UV/morph/hinge/socket and shared texture corruption.
